description: Normalize KiCad placement rotations for JLCPCB, PCBWay and MacroFab — corrected CPL, straight from the PCB editor.
description_full: CPLfix sends the open board's placement to the free CPLfix API (cplfix.com) and saves a corrected CPL next to the board file as cpl-<cm>.csv. Rotations come from the API, never from a local table: JLCPCB bottom = (180 - rot + delta) % 360, PCBWay and MacroFab rotations pass through as-is. No accounts, no API key, no payment. Works with KiCad 7, 8 and 9 (SWIG pcbnew runtime). Always verify every part in your CM's placement preview before ordering — it is the final authority.
name: CPLfix
